name: aria
description: Connect Claude Code to Aria. Sign in with /aria:connect. She reads your memory before planning, queues work to this session by voice or text, texts you the result, and lets you talk to this session from the Aria app.

api_key.title: Aria API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave this empty and run /aria:connect with the setup link Aria texts you - it stores the key in ~/.aria/credentials for you. Set it here only if you already hold an aria_sk_ key and would rather keep it in the OS keychain. A key set here wins over the file.

mcp_url.title: Aria MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: The remote MCP server. Leave the default unless you are testing against your own deployment.

backend_url.title: Aria backend
backend_url.description: REST backend the Stop hook posts session summaries to. Different host from the MCP endpoint; leave the default.
